ShortDescription.Value: A cheat mod that keeps your city budget positive with configurable automatic boosts

Publish.LongDescription:
# Budget Booster
**A cheat mod that keeps your city budget positive, so you can build without watching the bank balance.**
This is explicitly a cheat mod. If managing your city's finances is the part of the game you enjoy, this mod is not for you. If you would rather spend your time designing, it removes the money problem and gets out of the way.
## Boost modes
Pick how the mod tops you up, in Options - Mods - Budget Booster:
- **Auto-Balance** - only adds money when your balance drops below a target you set. Adds just enough to recover, so it feels like a safety net rather than infinite cash. - **Fixed Boost** - adds a set amount every cycle. A steady income stream for creative building. - **Percentage** - scales with your city. Reads your city's actual total expenses from the game's budget system and adds a percentage of them, so the help grows as your city does.
## Quick presets
One click sets everything up:
- **Casual Builder** - gentle $250K Auto-Balance. Stress-free building, still some challenge. - **Sandbox Mode** - $5M Fixed Boost. Unlimited creative building. - **Growing City** - Percentage mode at 25%. Organic scaling, less micromanagement. - **Emergency Only** - $50K at $0. A bankruptcy safety net that still feels fair.
## Everything is configurable
Sliders in the in-game options menu for boost amount, target surplus, boost percentage, a maximum per cycle safety cap, and how often the mod checks. Options that do not apply to your chosen mode hide themselves, so the panel stays readable.
## Session statistics
See how much the mod has actually done for you: boosts applied, total money added, your last boost, and current balance. Counters cover the current session and reset when you restart the game.
## Notifications
Choose how much you hear about it - off, minimal (only large boosts), normal, or detailed with balance and running totals.
## Troubleshooting built in
A Debug section with detailed logging and a **Run Diagnostics** button that writes a full system report to the log, covering the mod's status, your settings, and whether it can read your city's money and expenses. If something looks wrong, that report is the first thing to check, and the most useful thing to attach to a bug report.
## Compatibility
- Works on existing saves. Install or remove at any time. - Removing the mod leaves your money alone. Your save stays compatible with the base game. - May conflict with other mods that change the economy or write to the city's money.
## Bugs and feedback
Please report issues on GitHub with your game version, the mod version, the output of **Run Diagnostics**, and steps to reproduce.
Publish.ChangeLog: - Percentage mode now scales with your city's real expenses, read from the game's budget system. It previously always fell back to scaling the Boost Amount slider, so it never actually grew with your city. Existing Percentage mode users will see larger boosts and may want to lower the percentage. - Fixed session statistics being saved to disk, which made them accumulate across restarts while labelled as per-session. They now reset each time you launch the game. - Fixed settings being written under two different names internally, which could leave configuration stranded. Existing settings are migrated automatically on first launch.
